formal_scope: Actual permutation marking on Fin10: distinct nonidentity involutions, all distant commutations, nontrivial common element in actual generated subgroups on disjoint label sets, hence failure of the full subgroup-intersection property.
point_convention: Written point k corresponds to (k-1 : Fin10). Generator labels already run from0 to4.

definitions.generated_subgroup: Subgroup.closure of the actual image of a set of labels under delta
definitions.C_property: For all label sets I,J, their generated subgroups meet in the subgroup generated by I intersection J.

proof_method: Finite permutation identities by kernel-checked decide; membership via subset_closure, multiplication and powers; contradiction from closure of empty set. No native_decide.
not_formalized: Its exact fracture graph, perfect split, endpoint movement and identification with the printed operation.
The source theorem and standard end criterion used in the written old-C proof.
